mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above its 5-year moving average indicates robust demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding phases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE above 7.5%) in a labor market already at 7.5% signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in this regime are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not exceed 7.5% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 2%) and rising industrial production (INDPRO > 98.7439) creates expansionary conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect's rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-month window, or the combined signal does not predict positive returns in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 232.34) during a monetary tightening cycle signals cost pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In tightening cycles, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 232.34 in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high employment (PAYEMS > 135,000 units) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or PAYEMS does not remain above 135,000 for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Over-supply in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO does not exceed 100 in the next week.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 2%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) creates uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect's rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-month window, or the combined signal does not predict negative returns in 80% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) signals peak growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not exceed 7.5% in the next month during this regime.
